title.en: See it before you eat it

caption.en: Pick up a steak and the shanks and hearts it will restore start flashing; eat it and the golden saturation outlines appear.
caption.zh-CN: 拿起牛排，它能补回的鸡腿和心形就开始闪烁；吃下去后，金色的饱和度轮廓随之出现。

caption.en: Holding a steak at 10 hunger and 4.5 hearts: four shanks and the regenerated hearts flash on the HUD.
caption.zh-CN: 饥饿值 10、生命 4.5 颗心时手持牛排：HUD 上闪烁着四个鸡腿和能回复的心。

title.zh-CN: 每个提示框里都有食物数值

caption.en: Shanks for hunger, golden icons for saturation. Rotten flesh gets the green bad-food shanks.
caption.zh-CN: 鸡腿代表饥饿值，金色图标代表饱和度；腐肉用的是绿色的坏食物鸡腿。

caption.en: Hover a food in your inventory or a chest; the values sit under its name.
caption.zh-CN: 在物品栏或箱子里把鼠标移到食物上，数值就显示在名字下面。

caption.en: Not enough hunger to regenerate? The hearts still flash the health the golden apple's Regeneration gives back.
caption.zh-CN: 饥饿值不够自然回血？心形依然会闪烁显示金苹果的生命恢复效果能回多少血。

caption.en: Risky food previews with the green hunger-effect shanks, so you know what you are getting into.
caption.zh-CN: 有风险的食物用绿色的饥饿效果鸡腿预览，吃之前心里有数。

caption.en: Golden outlines show the saturation left before your hunger starts to drop; the checkered bar behind the shanks is your exhaustion.
caption.zh-CN: 金色轮廓是饥饿值开始下降前剩余的饱和度；鸡腿后面的格纹条是消耗度。

title.zh-CN: 按 F6 查看精确数值

caption.en: Your precise hunger, saturation and exhaustion at the top left, whenever you want them.
caption.zh-CN: 左上角显示精确的饥饿值、饱和度和消耗度，想看就看。
